spans.title: Important note
spans.text: On small boards, fixed-size arrays and automatic lifetime are often simpler, faster, and safer. Repeated heap allocation and release can fragment memory: total free bytes may look sufficient while no single large block is available. Release each allocation exactly once with its matching function, then set the pointer to `nullptr`. Use `size_t` for sizes. An Arduino UNO has very little SRAM; on ESP32, `ESP.getFreeHeap()` and minimum-free-heap measurements help diagnose usage but do not replace a memory budget. Check `realloc` into a temporary pointer so failure does not lose the original block.
